args.sql:
WITH ape_rank AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.botdetreg, 
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ctrltypeval ORDER BY AVG(t2.poserrmmval) DESC) AS ape_rank
    FROM robot_details AS t1
    JOIN actuation_data AS t2 ON t1.botdetreg = t2.actdetref
    GROUP BY t1.botdetreg
)
SELECT 
    t1.ctrltypeval AS controller_type, 
    AVG(t2.poserrmmval) AS average_position_error, 
    MAX(t4.ape_rank) AS max_ape_rank, 
    AVG(t3.faultpredscore) AS average_recent_fault_prediction_score, 
    COUNT(t1.botdetreg) AS robot_count
FROM 
    robot_details AS t1
JOIN 
    maintenance_and_fault AS t3 ON t1.botdetreg = t3.upkeeprobot
JOIN 
    actuation_data AS t2 ON t1.botdetreg = t2.actdetref
JOIN 
    ape_rank AS t4 ON t1.botdetreg = t4.botdetreg
WHERE 
    t3.issuelevelval IN ('Low', 'Medium') AND 
    DATE_PART('year', AGE(CURRENT_DATE, t1.instdateval)) > 5
GROUP BY 
    t1.ctrltypeval
ORDER BY 
    t1.ctrltypeval;

WITH ape_rank AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.botdetreg, 
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ctrltypeval ORDER BY AVG(t3.qualitymeasureval) DESC) AS ape_rank
    FROM robot_details AS t1
    JOIN performance_and_safety AS t3 ON t1.botdetreg = t3.effectivenessrobot
    GROUP BY t1.botdetreg
)
SELECT 
    t1.ctrltypeval AS controller_type, 
    AVG(t3.qualitymeasureval) AS average_position_error, 
    MAX(t4.ape_rank) AS max_ape_rank, 
    AVG(t2.faultpredscore) AS average_recent_fault_prediction_score, 
    COUNT(t1.botdetreg) AS robot_count
FROM 
    robot_details AS t1
JOIN 
    maintenance_and_fault AS t2 ON t1.botdetreg = t2.upkeeprobot
JOIN 
    performance_and_safety AS t3 ON t1.botdetreg = t3.effectivenessrobot
JOIN 
    ape_rank AS t4 ON t1.botdetreg = t4.botdetreg
WHERE 
    t2.issuelevelval IN ('Low', 'Medium') AND 
    DATE_PART('year', AGE(CURRENT_DATE, t1.instdateval)) > 5
GROUP BY 
    t1.ctrltypeval
ORDER BY 
    t1.ctrltypeval;
